title: Mean of a subspace character sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, where $\mathbb{F}_2$ is the field with two elements. The uniform expectation over $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ of the sum of the characters indexed by elements of $H$, evaluated at $x$, is $1$.
